target.title: fix(agents): bound compaction planning worker payloads
target.body:
Addresses #100635

## What Problem This Solves

Compaction planning sanitizes private fields before worker handoff, but previously still sent full model-visible tool-result text and base64 image data through `workerData`. Large browser/command results or multimodal transcripts could therefore force multi-megabyte structured-clone work before summary-prompt truncation had a chance to help.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a planning-only projection before worker handoff:

- oversized tool-result text/content keeps a bounded UTF-16-safe sample plus omitted-character accounting;
- image blocks in user, custom, and tool-result content keep their type/MIME metadata but omit base64 bytes;
- token-pressure accounting remains conservative, so chunking and pruning decisions still reflect the original payload;
- local fallback behavior and private-field sanitization remain unchanged.

Image bytes are not used by compaction's text serializer, while image token pressure is a fixed per-block estimate. Omitting only `data` therefore reduces worker cloning without changing summary text or planning pressure. The pure projection helper is split from worker orchestration so both implementation files remain below the repository's 500-line guard (476 and 109 lines).

## User Impact

Long or multimodal sessions should spend less time and memory cloning redundant payloads into the compaction planning worker, reducing event-loop stall and OOM risk without changing compaction decisions or generated summary text.

## Evidence

- Final `upstream/main` rebase: `26210c16003f16768b02e989af773e536b15d6f2`; branch HEAD: `0899710631f6350c8fe34e238a9d12049415b0b9`.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/agents/compaction.token-sanitize.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/harness/compaction/compaction-image-tokens.test.ts`: 13 tests passed across 3 files on the final rebased HEAD.
- `pnpm check:loc --base-ref upstream/main`: passed; implementation files are 476 and 109 lines.
- Changed-file `oxlint` and `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`: passed.
- Core production typecheck passed locally. The same code also passed the repository build and CI `build-artifacts` lane before the final baseline-only rebase.
- Independent `codex review --uncommitted`: no correctness findings after fixing the user-image coverage gap it identified.
- Text projection microbenchmark:
  - 1 x 120k-char tool result: `120,134` -> `8,436` bytes (`92.98%` reduction), token estimate `30,000` -> `30,001`.
  - 65 x 40k-char tool results: `2,608,758` -> `548,258` bytes (`78.98%` reduction), token estimate `650,000` -> `650,065`.
- Packaged-worker image smoke using `dist/agents/compaction-planning.worker.js` with one 1 MB user image and one 1 MB tool-result image in a 64-message request:
  - worker input: `2,251,077` -> `251,167` bytes (`88.8424%` reduction; `1,999,910` bytes removed);
  - token estimate: `2,405` -> `2,405`;
  - serialized summary input: identical;
  - worker result: `ok`.

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed the compaction planning and worker handoff paths, checked duplicate/open PR state for #100635, and independently reviewed and validated the final branch locally.

Signed-off-by: Ho Lim <subhoya@gmail.com>
